m.d: An axe is a tool made from a short blade on a long handle. Axes are often used to cut wood.
If you axe something, you chop it with an axe.
If you axe something, you end or reduce it in a sudden or mean way.
m.e: The government announced its plans to axe public spending.

m.d: If you axe someone, you fire a person from their job.
m.e: He got axed in the last round of firings.

m.d: Ax is another way of spelling axe.
Ax is another way of spelling axe.
An axel is a jump that includes one or more complete turns and a half turn while in the air.
An axis is the imaginary line that an object spins around. This is the middle of the circle of the turn, and at a right angle to it.
m.e: The Earth rotates once a day on its axis.

An axle is the pin or spindle on which a wheel revolves, or which revolves with a wheel.
An axle is a transverse bar or shaft connecting the opposite wheels of a vehicle.
